# John the Ripper

`john` &middot; _password-attacks_

Recovers passwords from hashes you already hold, using a wordlist or rules.

**Moderate impact.** It touches the target directly; keep the scope tight.

## What this tool needs

- One or more password hashes (one per line).
- A wordlist for best results (the runtime ships common ones).

## How to use it

Paste hashes, then John identifies the format and attacks them. Use this to check the strength of hashes you own (e.g. auditing your own systems). Never crack hashes you are not authorised to possess.

## Examples

```console
$ john --wordlist=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt hashes.txt
$ john --show hashes.txt
```
